sourceNote: Back cover of the book (no folio). The back cover shows a photograph of a fortified gateway, the Urdu heading "قومی ترانہ" (National Anthem) with the anthem text printed under it, and the line "Code No. PSP/IFS-6-25-2021 · Quantity 30,000 · Price 193.00 · Printed by Idara-e-Farogh-o-Adab Science". The anthem text itself is not transcribed here (song lyrics are not reproduced); only its heading is recorded. A CamScanner watermark crosses the page.
